# AI workflow automation

The use of artificial intelligence to automate complex workflows, particularly in operational contexts like incident management. [[Álvaro Jiménez Martínez]] designed and deployed an AI workflow at [[BHS Corrugated Spain]] that automated Jira incident diagnosis for corrugator machines. Using n8n and Python, the workflow reduced manual ticket handling by 40%. The workflow incorporated [[Safe-by-design AI]] principles, [[Tool calling]] with [[Azure]] LLMs, and a [[Continuous improvement system]] to autonomously detect issues and optimize itself.

## Key Technologies

- n8n (workflow automation)
- Python (glue code)
- Azure LLMs (tool calling)
